name: medical_appointment_operation
description: Medical appointment system tool that supports booking, querying, modifying, and canceling appointments. The return result includes whether the operation was successful (success) and specific results (result).

operation.description: Operation type: book (make an appointment), query (check appointment), modify (change appointment), cancel (cancel appointment)

user_name.description: User's name, used for booking, querying, and modifying operations

user_phone.description: User's phone number, used for booking, querying, and modifying operations

user_id.description: User's ID number (optional), used for booking and querying operations

illness_description.description: Description of illness, used only for booking operations

desired_date.description: Desired appointment date (format: YYYY-MM-DD), used for booking and modifying operations

appointment_id.description: Appointment ID, used for querying, modifying, and canceling operations

status.description: Appointment status (pending/confirmed/cancelled), used for querying operations

hospital.description: Hospital name, used for querying operations

department.description: Department name, used for querying operations
